1:5.note: Syriac paraphrases: 'to the place where it rose it returns, so that from there it rises again'.

1:10.note: Yesh davar rendered 'everything that one speaks'; second hayah minus.

1:13.note: Syriac 'under the sun' for 'under the heavens'; hu minus.

2:3.note: Syriac 'under the sun' for 'under the heavens'.

2:8.note: Plus 'I made for myself'; shiddah rendered 'cupbearers'.

2:12.note: Syriac adds 'in judgment' and reads 'with him who made him'.

2:16.note: Plus clause 'because the fool speaks too much' at start.

3:1.note: Syriac 'under the sun' for 'under the heavens'.

3:15.note: Nirdaf rendered 'the pursued who is pursued'.

3:19.note: Syriac 'to them comes the fate'; ki minus.

3:21.note: Syriac 'whether' for interrogative; first hi minus.

4:17.note: Plus 'better'; Syriac 'do good' for 'do evil'; ketiv/qere raglekha.

5:16.note: Plus 'and in wrath and in mourning'.

6:8.note: Syriac 'that there is advantage' for 'what advantage'.

7:11.note: Im nachalah rendered 'than weapons of war'.

8:1.note: Oz panaw rendered 'the impudent of face'.

8:7.note: Syriac 'and what will be after him'; plus 'after him'.

8:8.note: Mishlachat rendered 'escape on the day of battle'.

9:1.note: Velavur read as 'and my heart saw'; final 'vanity' reads hevel for hakkol of 9:2.

9:4.note: Qere yechubbar rendered 'is joined'; ketiv yivchar shown with it.

9:9.note: Minus 'which he gave you under the sun, all the days of your vanity' (homoioteleuton).

10:1.note: Plus 'vessel'; yabbia minus; kavod rendered 'abundance of glory'.

10:3.note: Syriac 'all that he thinks is folly'; ketiv/qere keshehassakhal.

10:19.note: Plus 'oil'; ya'aneh rendered 'humbles and leads astray'.

11:5.note: Ka'atsamim rendered 'like the nature (of the embryo)'.

12:5.note: Doublets: 'sleeplessness springs on him'/'the almond blossoms' for 6-7 and 'caper is scattered'/'desire ceases' for 10-11; olamo read as 'his toil'.

12:13.note: Plus 'in its sum' and 'which was given from one Shepherd' (cf. 12:11); enclitic hu with zeh.
